new.name: EthanArbuckle/fairplay-decrypt
new.desc: Offline FairPlay App Store IPA decryption with independent key derivation
new.readme: IPA decryptor Decrypt FairPlay encrypted apps using a 16 byte credential for the account that owns each IPA. Credential retrieval gets it from a supported jailbroken device and writes credential.bin to the chosen output directory. Decryption runs on macOS and Linux. Supports version 3 and version 5 SUPF, 448 byte and 440 byte SINF priv records, and encrypted arm64 Mach O slices. A 440 byte record must end in eight zero bytes. Set up From this directory, with Python 3.9+ and a C compiler: On macOS, make also builds the credential retrieval bundle and requires Xcode and ldid . On Linux, it builds the decryptor. Decrypt If credential is omitted, the tool reads ./credential.bin . The output path must not exist. The decryptor uses each IPA's SINF and SUPF records to derive page keys, decrypt its encrypted arm64 pages, and clear cryptid .

new.readme: 简体中文 English huashu motion 「一键直出商业级产品宣传片。」 让你的agent做动画、作曲，指着画面改。 跟Claude Code、Codex这些agent说一句「给我的产品做个30秒的发布片」， 它会先读你的产品，给你三个方向挑，写出整支片子，自己写谱配乐， 然后在浏览器里打开一个编辑器等你。哪里不满意，在画面上点一下，写下要改什么，它就只改那一处。 看效果 · 安装 · 能做什么 · 怎么做到的 · 背后的故事 看效果 这篇README里的每一段动画都是huashu motion做的。上面那段取自它给自己做的53秒发布片，👉 下载完整发布片（MP4，带声音），下面Grok Bot（非官方）、huashu design、DeepSeek、Claude Duet（非官方）这几支的完整版也在同一个页面。 指着画面改 按C，在画面上点一下，写下要改什么。评论发过去的时候带着时间点、场景、点中的元素和它在源码里的位置，agent先把那一帧和你点的那一小块截图放大看一眼，再只改那一处，改完回一句人话，预览停在原来的位置刷新。每一版都留着，⌘Z随时撤回；标题、数字、颜色、停留时长这些会变成编辑器右边的输入框，自己改，不用等agent。 （这段里的编辑器和终端是照真实界面重建的，代码细节是示意；评论是真实提过的意见。） 先写谱，再拍片 做发布片用的是作曲家模式：agent按节奏单先写一份谱（ABC记谱法，纯文本的乐谱），谱里的标记对齐每个场景，再由三角钢琴、弦乐和鼓组的采样演奏出来（真乐器采样要先跑一次 om samples build ，不跑就用合成音色）；画面上每个东西落地的那一帧，再配一个音效。配乐全部在本机现场生成，不调用任何收费接口。 一天，二十支 16个镜头，来自同一天做的七支片子，按拍子切。 Grok Bot（粉丝自制，非官方）· 30秒：傍晚交代任务，夜里几个agent各干各的，早上7点手机上收到汇报。这段是汇报一张张送往Chief of Staff的那几拍。 huashu design 3.0 · 一句提示词钉住不动，背后的风格按拍子换 小

new.readme: 麦门省钱精算师 · mcd saver strategist 基于 麦当劳中国 MCP（McDonald's China MCP） 开发的省钱点餐 Skill / AI 智能体技能： 把「菜单 × 优惠券 × 叠加规则」的组合优化交给确定性算法， 让每一顿麦麦都点得明明白白、省得清清楚楚。 又名：麦门省钱精算师 / 麦当劳省钱点餐助手 / MCD Saver Strategist。 麦当劳程序员创意开发大赛参赛作品 · 非麦当劳官方产品。 项目介绍 用户说"我想吃巨无霸套餐，怎么最便宜"，它拉取门店菜单和所有可用优惠券， 用算法穷举出总价最低的合规组合，并帮你下单。 示例：巨无霸 + 中薯条 + 可乐，直选 ¥47.00 ； 用「1+1 随心配」组合后 ¥21.90 ，省 ¥25.10（53%） 。 它不止会算"最便宜"，还能回答四个衍生问题： 问题 能力 这顿饭我想省钱 / 吃全 / 低卡 / 少排队 多目标优化 ：4 种点餐目标，同一约束给不同最优解 手里这堆券，哪张优惠更实在？ 券体检 ：名义面额 vs 实际节省 vs 机会成本 差几块钱到下一档满减，加购划不划算？ 凑单建议 ：最小代价补位，算出净变化（可能为负） 便宜和低卡不可兼得，边界在哪？ 帕累托前沿 ：价格 × 热量的不可支配解集 一家人 / 一桌同事怎么点？ 多人拼单 ：按份数计价、人均分摊，优惠只计一次（保守） 🎮 在线试算（无需登录） ： —— 优化算法的前端完整复刻，选好想吃的、切换目标、拖动预算和热量上限，实时算出最优组合； 页面里还有券体检和帕累托前沿图，打开即玩。 🔎 静态示例： docs/demo.html · 🖼️ 原理图： images/how it works.png · 🎬 宣传动画： images/promo.mp4 它解决什么问题 麦当劳的优惠是典型的 组合爆炸 问题： 菜单几十项、优惠券动辄十几张、叠加规则各不相同； 用券还要考虑「为凑满减而加购是否划算」； 用户懒得算，大模型 也容易算错 （价格、折扣、叠加口算不可靠）。 本 Skill 的核心洞察是： 取数交给 MCP，算

new.desc: Compass: run your whole life out of Obsidian. Daily questions, quarterly retreats, planning, habits, tasks, writing, and an AI assistant in the vault.
new.readme: Life OS Run your whole life out of Obsidian: one honest question set a night, everything else follows. Compass is a complete Obsidian vault template of the system Mike Schmitz describes in "How I Run My Whole Life Out of Obsidian": journaling with daily questions, quarterly personal retreats, multi scale planning, habit tracking, daily reading, task management, writing boards, and a DataviewJS dashboard that ties it together. The first party Life OS application now sits above those workflows, with an AI assistant that reads AGENTS.md and runs a library of approval aware prompts. Everything remains plain Markdown and properties. Ten community plugins and the first party Life OS plugin ship inside the folder with their licenses. Status: development candidate, not a newly accepted public release. The existing 1.0.2 archives predate the Life OS application. The next template candidate is 1.1

new.name: atlas-vtt/atlas-vtt
new.desc: Open Source virtual tabletop for Obsidian: battle maps, tokens, fog of war, dice, initiative and a separate player view.
new.readme: AtlasVTT A game system agnostic virtual tabletop for tabletop RPGs that runs inside Obsidian. The guides, with screenshots and clips of every feature, are on atlas vtt.dev . I built Atlas as part of my bachelor's thesis to give the TTRPG community a virtual tabletop that's open source, hackable, and free to use. Every file Atlas creates, every token, every map, every world you build, stays yours and stays local. It follows the same philosophy as Obsidian: your work lives on your machine, in formats you control, with no account and no server in between. Atlas VTT also has an online play service, Atlas Online, to share your maps with players over the internet. Atlas Online requires an account and an internet connection. TTRPG worlds in my opinion are something very personal and players and DMs get attached to them. That attachment deserves better than a subscription and someone else's data

new.readme: Life OS 简体中文版 在 Obsidian 中管理日记、目标、习惯、任务、项目、写作、阅读和人生复盘。 [!important] 原项目与作者 本项目是 Compass 的非官方简体中文本地化版本。原项目由 Daniel Agrici（@AgriciDaniel） 创建和维护。本仓库仅负责中文本地化与兼容性调整，不代表原作者发布的官方中文版。 本版本保留了原项目的 Markdown 数据结构、系统属性键和工作流兼容性，并对 Life OS 主界面、主要仪表盘、模板、配置说明和示例内容进行了中文化。 当前版本： v1.1.0 zh.1 发布状态：预发布候选版。自动化验证已经通过，但尚未完成所有平台的 Obsidian 原生验收，也没有验证所有第三方插件的上游二进制来源。 主要功能 每日笔记与每日自省问题 周度、季度与个人静修复盘 生命之轮和习惯追踪 任务收件箱、项目管理和联系人跟进 Newsletter、视频、文章和课程创作看板 本地知识库、阅读计划和关联大脑 Life OS 原生导航、快速记录和实时仪表盘 可选的 Agent Client、提示词库和 Obsidian MCP 工作流 数据以 Markdown、YAML 属性和双链形式保存在本地 中文化范围 本版本已处理： Life OS 导航、按钮、卡片、状态、统计和动态计数 首页、规划、专注、复盘、项目、人际、创作、知识库、大脑和 AI 模块 快速记录弹窗与系统状态 人生罗盘配置页 AI 助手安全说明 示例项目、示例任务和可见文件名 主要仪表盘、模板与 QuickAdd 显示名称 为了保持兼容性，以下内容不会翻译： dq 、 habit 、 wheel 等属性键 Tasks、Dataview、Templater 和 Agent Client 的代码语法 插件 ID、命令 ID、标签和部分内部路径 发送给智能体执行的英文 Prompt 指令 第三方插件自身未提供中文的设置页面 快速开始 1. 从 GitHub Releases 下载 LifeOS zh CN template v1.1.0 zh.1.zip 。

new.name: joeseesun/qiaomu-cover-fonts
new.desc: 乔木封面设计的默认开源字库：中文与英文 OFL 字体，子集化并附授权 · Default open-licence font library for Qiaomu Cover Design
new.readme: 乔木封面字库 · Qiaomu Cover Fonts 乔木封面设计（Qiaomu Cover Design） 的默认字库：一套随插件交付、装好就能用的封面字体。不追求数量， 中文 19 款、英文 15 款 ，每一款都在封面上有明确的位置；全部 SIL Open Font License 1.1，中文覆盖《通用规范汉字表》8105 字，共 30.7 MB。 The default font library of Qiaomu Cover Design: 34 curated open licence fonts (19 Chinese, 15 Latin, 30.7 MB) that every cover can use out of the box, all under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. 先说结论 1. 不需要装进电脑系统。 插件自己把字体载入画布，导出的图片里字已经是像素，换台电脑看也一样。 2. 门槛是“打包权”。 只有 SIL OFL 开源字体允许随产品分发、并为了体积做子集化；大厂“免费商用”字体多数禁止修改或单独再分发，不能放进默认包。每一款都读过字体文件里的授权声明，并核对了保留字体名。 3. 第一次打开静默下载。 Obsidian 插件商店只安装 3 个文件，所以字库从这里分发：插件首次打开时在后台下载，默认模板要用的字优先，用到哪款就立刻下哪款，逐个校验 SHA 256，之后离线可用。 4. 模板只用字库里的字 ，新用户第一次看到的就是设计稿原样。 5. 以“字体搭配”为单位排版。 标题、正文、英文数字三个角色一次定好，AI 也按搭配来设计。好的排版靠层级和搭配，不靠字体多。 12 套字体搭配 每张都是在乔木封面设计里用同一个版式、换不同搭配实际渲染的。标题用中文展示字体，副标题用安静的正文字体，期号和英文角标自动换成搭配里的英文字体。 编辑杂志 editorial 思源宋体 Heavy · 思源黑体 · Instrument Serif 深度长文、观点、访谈 文化书卷 literary 朱雀仿宋 · 霞鹜

new.readme: Hermes Official Plugins ☤ The official plugins for Hermes Agent , built and maintained by Nous Research . One repo, every first party plugin, installed in one line from the Hermes plugin catalog. What is Hermes Agent? Hermes Agent is the self improving AI agent from Nous Research. It writes skills from experience and keeps improving them as it works, remembers what matters across sessions, and runs where you are: the terminal, the Hermes Desktop app, Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal and more, all through one gateway. You can bring any model (Nous Portal, OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, your own endpoint) and run it on a laptop, a $5 VPS or serverless infrastructure. A lean core, with plugins at the edges The Hermes core keeps the parts every user needs: the agent loop, memory, skills, the gateway, model routing and the tool runtime. Everything specific to one product, one vendor

new.desc: Maintenance explorer for Home Assistant: inventory, diagnosis, impact analysis and confirmed, reversible cleanup
new.readme: HA Housekeeper Maintenance and analysis for Home Assistant: inventory, diagnostics, and dependencies at a glance. Deutsche Version HA Housekeeper is a maintenance and analysis integration for Home Assistant. It creates a clear inventory of your installation, explains suspicious or orphaned objects, and shows how entities, devices, integrations, areas, and automations depend on each other. The goal is not aggressive automatic cleanup. Housekeeper helps you understand what exists, why something is considered problematic, and what a cleanup or repair would affect before you confirm it. Housekeeper reads and analyzes first. It changes something only after you explicitly confirm a plan. Plans cover quarantine and removal, repairs, replacing references, renaming entities, assigning areas, deleting unused automations, trimming recorder history and other maintenance tasks. Pick from 80 objects — no training. Name people by their face once; every camera knows them. Emma recognised by her face, and our own car told apart from any other car. A few photos from your phone are enough to start; faces never leave your Home Assistant. 🔢 Readings The water, gas or power meter , the minutes left on the washer. Draw a box around the number. new.readme: Klangbild Klangbild shows the music that's playing as a calm picture on your TV, made to look nice in the room it's in. Everything on the screen is balanced around the album cover and takes its colors from it. You choose the music on your phone as usual. What it does It works with any media player in Home Assistant. Music Assistant adds the queue, lyrics and audiobook chapters, the lights behind the TV can glow in the cover's colors, and with Sendspin the TV can become a speaker. [!NOTE] Klangbild is being built in two phases. The first, the Now Playing screen, is nearly finished. Next comes a music visualizer that reacts to all kinds of things while staying calm and tasteful rather than psychedelic. Eventually, it will replace the landscape. new.desc: Home calendar card for HA
new.readme: Home Calendar Card A clean, modern calendar card for Home Assistant. Shows your Google , Apple iCloud (via CalDAV) or any other Home Assistant calendar in Agenda , Week , Month and Planner views, with the daily weather forecast on every day — and lets you add events straight from the dashboard, choosing which calendar they go into. Screenshots Wall display – Month (Midnight) Wall display – Week (Sunset) Wall display – Agenda (Forest) Adding an event Planner view – a column for each person (Midnight) Five colour themes On a phone (Graphite) Screenshots use a fictional family – all names, places and events are made up. Features 📅 Four views – Agenda (grouped by day), Week (7 columns, stacks on phones), Month (grid, dots on phones) and Planner (a column per person, like a printed family planner) 🌦️ Weather built in – current conditions in the header, daily icon, high/low and rain chance on
